steps.title: 01-open: Open http://127.0.0.1:8069/ and sign in with username admin and password {{env:APP_PASSWORD}}. Once signed in, create a new customer (contact) named '{{runid}} Bench Customer' with the City field set to 'Benchville'. Save the record and report the customer name and city exactly as shown on the saved record.

02-create: In Odoo, go to the Sales app and create a new quotation (RFQ/sales order) for the customer '{{runid}} Bench Customer' (choose them from the autocomplete dropdown, not just typed). Add exactly ONE order line: pick any product from the product catalogue using the product autocomplete dropdown, and set the quantity to 3. Let Odoo fill in the unit price automatically. Save the quotation. Report: (a) the product name you chose, (b) the unit price Odoo filled in for that line, and (c) the untaxed amount the quotation computes.

03-add: On the existing Odoo quotation {{02-create.quotation_reference}} (customer {{runid}} Bench Customer), which currently has one order line for '{{02-create.product_name}}' quantity 3, add a SECOND order line for a DIFFERENT product (pick one from the product autocomplete dropdown; avoid the 'Customizable Desk' template since it opens a configurator dialog, unless it's the only option). Set the second line's quantity to 2, let Odoo auto-fill the price, and save the quotation. Report: (a) the second product's name, (b) its unit price, and (c) the new total untaxed amount the quotation computes.

04-change: On the Odoo quotation {{02-create.quotation_reference}} (customer {{runid}} Bench Customer) which has two order lines, change the quantity of the FIRST line (product '{{02-create.product_name}}', currently quantity 3) to 5. Leave the second line ('{{03-add.line2_product}}', qty 2) unchanged. Save the quotation. Report the new untaxed amount the quotation computes, and also the new per-line and total amounts shown.

05-report: On the Odoo quotation {{02-create.quotation_reference}} (customer {{runid}} Bench Customer, untaxed amount {{04-change.untaxed_amount}}), confirm the quotation so it becomes a sales order (click the Confirm button). Report: (a) the order reference/name (e.g. S00042) shown after confirmation, and (b) the status the app now shows (e.g. 'Sales Order' or 'Confirmed').

06-report: On the confirmed Odoo sales order {{02-create.quotation_reference}} (customer {{runid}} Bench Customer, status 'Sales Order'), cancel the order (click the Cancel button and confirm any dialog that appears). Report the status the app shows after cancelling.
